headline: Approved tax incentives for manufacturing at 72-86 Rossotto Drive and a Walkable Sidewalks project; tabled automated traffic enforcement rules.
summary: One member of the public spoke during public input. Information on upcoming meetings of three commissions was shared.
decisions: Approved an agreement for real property tax incentives for manufacturing at 72-86 Rossotto Drive, passed unanimously.
Approved a first supplemental project authorization letter with the state for Walkable Sidewalks construction project No. 61-153, passed unanimously.
Tabled the amendment and restatement of Chapter 73 on automated traffic enforcement safety devices.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
 
 
ENGINEERING, DEVELOPMENT & MUNICIPAL PLANNING 
COMMITTEE – AUGUST 10, 2026 – MINUTES DRAFT 
 
Committee Chair: 
 Present - Abdul Osmanu 
Committee Vice Chair: 
 Absent -Ted Stevens 
Committee Members: 
 Present - Sean Cardwell 
 Present - Grace Teodosio 
 Present - Rhonda Cardwell 
 Present - Jeron Alston 
 Present - Doug Foley 
 Present - Sarah Gallagher, Majority Leader 
Present - Bob Anthony, Minority Leader 
 Present - Katie Kiely, President 
  
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Engineering, Development & Municipal Planning Committee, August 10, 2026 – 7:00pm.  The 
meeting was called to order at 7:52pm with the members in attendance as noted above. 
  
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
One member of the public provided public comment. 
  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Information on upcoming meetings for the Community Development Advisory Commission, 
Economic Development Commission and Planning & Zoning Commission was shared.  There 
were no other Board, Committee or Department updates for this evening’s meeting. 
  
4. ACTION ITEMS 
  
  1. ORDER APPROVING AND AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR TO SIGN AN 
AGREEMENT FOR REAL PROPERTY TAX INCENTIVES FOR MANUFACTURING 
USE- 72-86 ROSSOTTO DRIVE 
Chair Osmanu moved to open item 1 and the motion was seconded by Pro Tem 
Cardwell.  Director Fontana provided a brief overview and addressed a question from 
the Council. 
Vote: All in favor, the item passes unanimously.  
  2. ORDER APPROVING FIRST SUPPLEMENTAL PROJECT AUTHORIZATION 
LETTER WITH THE STATE OF CONNECTICUT DEPARTMENT OF 
TRANSPORTATION WALKABLE SIDEWALKS CONSTRUCTION PROJECT NO. 
61-153, FEDERAL PROJECT NO. (PEDS (253)
Council member Foley motioned to open the item, Majority Leader Gallagher 
seconded. Chief of Staff Peterson provided a quick overview of the item. There were 
no questions from members.  Vote: All in favor, the item passed unanimously.  
  
3. AMENDMENT AND RESTATEMENT OF CHAPTER 73 OF THE CODE OF 
ORDINANCES ESTABLISHING THE USE OF AUTOMATED TRAFFIC ENFORCEMENT 
SAFETY DEVICES IN THE TOWN OF HAMDEN PURSUANT TO THE AUTHORITY 
GRANTED IN PUBLIC ACT 23-116, AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS 
OF THE VISION ZERO COUNCIL 
This item was tabled. 
ADJOURN 
With no additional business before the Committee, Chair Osmanu adjourned the meeting at 
8:10pm.
